m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard, this is Snake Plizkin - the only one who's ever escaped from a Snakish Prison. Snake, have you considered my offer?
So let me get this straight - I take you back into that snake pit of a Prison, get you back out, and then together, we leave Istanboa?
That is our offer. You are not only doing us a favor, but also helping to liberate a Qhat heiress who's been wrongfully imprisoned.
Stop pretending you respect me, Mongu, because we both know otherwise. And look, I don't care about you, this Wizard, or any Qhat heiress.
I'm thinking... all right. Guess I'm in, but we're going to do this my way. You stick to the shadows, and the Wizard and I take the heat.
First, we need the Prison Blueprints. Architect's name is Antheemius. We'll have to rough up Street Vipers until they cough up his location.
Then we have a deal. I'll sneak down and scout out the Prison. You two get the Architect's location from the Vipers and then catch up.
You seek Architect Antheemius? The square of a Snake who designed the Prison? He deserves suffering. His home is right off the street.
You've learned the location of the Architect's studio? Very good. I went ahead and scouted out the Prison. It is... not what I expected.
At this point, I'll be honest - I can only offer so much assistance. Getting into Istanboa is one thing, but a Snakish Prison is another.
There is only one creature who has ever escaped from the Prison here, and I warn you, he is an unsavory character, and perhaps unreliable.
We have little choice though, so I have offered him a deal - he gets you into and out of the Prison, and we get him out of the city.
He's thinking about it now, but I expect he'll agree. Come, follow me to the safehouse where he has been hiding out from the Vipers.
